question: Can the original marked E8 charged response realize the alpha factor with exponent5/4 under the same source time and actual clocks?
scope: Conditional original E8 lattice-VOA vacuum with marked D5/A3 sector, regularized charged state and actual C/J matrices; no microscopic source selection.
summary_de: Die normierte gemeinsame D5/A3-Oszillatorgradantwort wird exakt konstruiert. Ein markiertes Referenz-Verhältnis liefert (1-uq)^(-5/4), die gemeinsame Quellenzeit dagegen Exponent2. Tatsächliche C/J-Uhren erhalten den festen D5-Projektor nicht; ein symmetrischer Ersatz stimmt nur in erster Antwortordnung. Physische Zustands-/Auslesewahl und u,q-Zuordnung bleiben offen.
summary_en: The normalized joint D5/A3 oscillator-grade response is constructed exactly. A marked reference ratio yields (1-uq)^(-5/4), whereas common source time yields exponent2. Actual C/J clocks do not preserve the fixed D5 projector; an invariant replacement matches only first response order. Physical state/readout selection and the u,q mapping remain open.
assumptions: Chosen E8 lattice-VOA vacuum and original marked D5/A3 embedding.
Regularized charged vector with free preparation radius0<r<1 and sector-resolved oscillator-grade readout.
Clock-invariant quadratic time conclusion applies only if actual C,J are symmetries of that same time.
positive_results: Explicit local T_D5 insertion retains the5/8 Ward coefficient in the full local E8 charged pair.
Joint normalized response G(q5,q3) has powers5/4 and3/4, with finite reference ratio G(q,1)/G(0,1)=(1-uq)^(-5/4).
Actual source root census and clock matrices supply exact covariance and noninvariance tests.
kills: Identification of the marked D5 oscillator-grade generating function with the unchanged full E8 source time in the stated vacuum model.
Claim that invariant quadratic averaging preserves the full marked response: the second cumulants differ by-15u/[32(1-u)^2].
leaves_open: Derive the charged preparation, sector-resolved physical instrument and reference normalization from the original P1 source.
Derive u=48c3^4 and q=exp(-2alpha) and outer uq/additive baseline from one source functional.
Show how source clocks transport the physical mark, or derive the relevant symmetry breaking.
Common physical derivation of the declared matter content already fixing M=10b1=40+1=41 (v159), its photon/source dictionary, interacting3+1D theory and gravitational normalization.
novelty_scope: Project-specific joint marked response and actual-clock comparison. Vertex/Ward/Fock identities and weights5/8,3/8 are prior mathematics; no claim of globally new theory.
